name: codex-advisor
description: Codex-native Astra advice for primary agents, with ordinary Astra solo work and user-owned model settings.

interface.shortDescription: Work in your primary session and consult Astra at decision boundaries.
interface.longDescription: Codex Advisor lets non-Astra primary agents implement work while consulting an independent Astra Advisor before consequential decisions and multi-step completion. Astra remains available for ordinary solo work without Architect-mode authorization. Primary model and reasoning settings remain user-owned. Required consultation pauses when actual model or effort evidence is unavailable or conflicting.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-advisor:orchestration to implement and verify this feature.
Consult the Astra Advisor at the required boundaries while preserving my primary model and reasoning effort.
